title: Raking Light
description: An old baseball card on a dark desk and a lamp in your hand, held low to the surface. Move it and the light rakes across the card, so every crease, worn corner, fingerprint and ridge of ink throws a long shadow away from the bulb.
intent: One light finished to the edge: a real point lamp grazing a height field, so the card's physical history only appears when you bring the light down to it.
